description: Head-movement mini-game G15: one slow left-to-right head scan, voice-guided. Tap start, one-prompt left calibration, turn to the left limit and hold, then scan slowly to the right limit; the scan counts only if it takes at least 8 seconds and passes through center, with a once-per-attempt slow-down warning above 45 deg/s. Never a circle, never back-and-forth, never fast. No camera, no mic/ASR.
name: slow-scan
